import sys, json, struct, hashlib, zlib
sys.path.insert(0,'project')
from wire import packet, payload, seal

ex=json.load(open('examples.json'))
case=ex[1]['input']['cases'][0]
tr=ex[1]['output']['cases'][0]['trace']
base=case['start'];D=case['words']
frames=[]
for r in range(4):
    frames.append((r,packet(r,(base+1-1)&0xffffff,ack=True,outgoing=True)))
vals=[[1,4294967295],[2,4294967295],[3,4294967295],[4,4294967295]]
agg=[(sum(v[j] for v in vals))&0xffffffff for j in range(D)]
for r in range(4):
    frames.append((r,packet(r,(base+0)&0xffffff,struct.pack('!%dI'%D,*agg),outgoing=True)))
ok=True
for (r,f),t in zip(frames,tr):
    if f.hex()!=t['hex']:
        ok=False; print('MISMATCH',r,f.hex()); print('       ',t['hex'])
print('frame match:',ok)
h=hashlib.sha256()
for r,f in frames: h.update(bytes((r,))+struct.pack('<I',len(f))+f)
print('sha match:', h.hexdigest()==ex[1]['output']['cases'][0]['wire_sha256'])
print('bytes', sum(len(f) for r,f in frames))
